LCD_CLK LCD_CLK

The display subsystem is implemented with the following clock max frequencies:
• LTDC pixel clock (pixel_clk): 150 MHz
• LTDC parallel interface (lcd_clk): 150 MHz (I/O ReTime mandatory)
• Register clocks (ck_icn_p_*): 200 MHz (all APB/AHB register files)
• AXI-Master clock (ck_icn_m_ltdc): 400 MHz
